biggest_catch: You get nothing until your friend sets up a direct deposit and maintains good standing for a full 90 days - and the reward is processed only after that 90-day period ends.
catches: Referred members must be new to Your Legacy Federal Credit Union and cannot be joint on any existing accounts.
Referred members must open a share and share draft account with a debit card, set up a direct deposit, and maintain good standing for a minimum of 90 days from the date of account opening.
Referrer receives a $50 deposit into their share account for each successful referral.
Cap: maximum $500 per calendar year (10 new members).
Rewards processed within a reasonable timeframe after the 90-day qualification period is met; Your Legacy FCU is not responsible for any tax implications.
The program is ongoing with no expiration date, but Your Legacy FCU reserves the right to modify, suspend, or terminate at any time without prior notice.
